sources.snippet: A standout contribution is the introduction of the *semantic extrapolation residual _u*, a computable, model-agnostic measure that predicts per-class transfer difficulty. This offers a principled criterion for understanding where zero-shot transfer succeeds or fails, even informing dataset curation and benchmark design.
